Welcome to the course website for Sta-209-04 (Applied Statistics). You can find the course syllabus linked below:

- [Click here](syllabus209f26.html) to view the course syllabus

You can locate course content by scrolling, or by using the navigation bar in the upper left.  

Please note that some material will not be posted until we've reached that point in the course.

## Course Materials

Course meetings typically involve a short lecture followed by a lab activity. Unless otherwise mentioned, all assignments are due by 11:59pm (midnight) on their due date.

$~$

### Exam #1 Content

**Week 0/1** - Statistical Thinking and Simple Hypothesis Tests

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
# x <- cars[1:3,]
# urls <- c("stackoverflow.com", "stats.stackexchange.com", "homebrew.stackexchange.com")
# linkID <- c("link1", "link2", "link3")
# x$website <- paste0("[", linkID, "](http://", urls, ")")
# kable(x)

x = data.frame(Date = c("Fri 8/28", "Mon 8/31", "Wed 9/2", "Fri 9/4"), 
               Lecture = c("[Statistical Thinking and Probability](s209f26/intro.pdf)", 
                           "[Hypothesis Testing (part 1: sampling)](s209f26/ht1.pdf)",
                           " ",
                           " "),
               Lab = c("[Lab 1 - A first hypothesis test](s209f26/first_test.html)", 
                       "Finish/discuss Lab 1",
                       "[Lab 2 - Intro to `R` and one-sample categorical data](s209f26/one_sample_cat.html)",
                       "Finish/discuss Lab 2"),
               Resources = c(" ", "[Ch 2.1 - Sampling Principles from Intro to Modern Statistics](https://openintrostat.github.io/ims/data-design.html) ", "[`R` Basics from Modern Statistics with R](https://www.modernstatisticswithr.com/thebasics.html)", " "))
knitr::kable(x, format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover"))
```

**Assignments and Deadlines**:

- Lab 1 is due Monday 8/31
- Labs 2 and 3 are due Wednesday 9/9
- [Homework 1](s209f26/hw1.html) is due ~~Friday 9/4~~ Tuesday 9/8

All assignments should be submitted via Canvas.
